package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestWebPracticeTargetSeedContainsPilotCanonicalIdentities(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/004_web_practice_targets.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(payload)
	for _, identity := range []string{
		"'html.structure', 'v1'",
		"'css.grid', 'v1'",
		"'javascript.dom-basics', 'v1'",
		"'javascript.dom-events', 'v1'",
		"'javascript.event-state', 'v1'",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, identity) {
			t.Fatalf("practice target seed is missing %s", identity)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(migration, "INSERT INTO target_prerequisite") {
		t.Fatal("practice target seed must include prerequisite edges")
	}
}

func TestLearningTargetStackMigrationIndexesPilotStacks(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/005_learning_target_stack.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(payload)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"CREATE TABLE learning_target_stack",
		"'go.syntax-basics', 'v1', 'go'",
		"'html.structure', 'v1', 'html'",
		"'css.grid', 'v1', 'css'",
		"'javascript.dom-events', 'v1', 'javascript'",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("learning target stack migration is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
}
